ratings_breakdown.summary_text: Customers find the phone's quality positive and appreciate its good battery life. reviews.text: No manual of instructions, a nughtmare to operate, Wanted me to open an account with a week later at 6:45Apple in order to download apps, this was a second nightmare, as when you are inputing youe password there is no way to see what ymou are writting , if you input a mistaken letter or number there is no way for you to know it. Then if that happens next time your password will fail , then comes the real problem , if you press "FORGOT YOUR PASSWORD" they lock your account for several day untit they call you. In my case they callled at 6:45 AM when I was asleep.After 2 weeks of nightmare I returned to my old Android phone and will not tuch again an Apple devise again
